mentions.name: Einbürgerungstest Practice
mentions.description: A super simple site offering mock exams for practicing the German Einbürgerungstest (citizenship test).
mentions.problem: The builder struggled to find mock exams while studying for the Einbürgerungstest in Germany.
mentions.audience: People studying for the German Einbürgerungstest (citizenship test).
mentions.source_excerpt: I struggled finding mock exams when I was studying for the Einburgerungstest in Germany so i built a super simple site to offer folks some mock exams to practice with https://www.einburgerungstestpractice.com
